title: Pili
body: Pilin leaves the cell two ways. A transmembrane construct stands it up as needles in the membrane. A secreted construct shoots it off as fragments. Expression sets how many needles a region grows and how long they are, and for the secreted form that length is the size of what gets fired.
A position tag keeps the coat on the sides it names. With no position tag the coat spreads over the whole membrane. The standing needles ride with the envelope. The secreted fragments leave.
